useWhen: Adding AI/ML features to a product
Need to integrate OpenAI, Claude, or other LLMs
Building AI-powered functionality like chat, summarization, or analysis
Setting up ML model fine-tuning or RAG pipelines

workflow.description: Define use case, select appropriate model (GPT, Claude, open-source), determine data requirements and preprocessing needs
Integrate API, design prompts, handle response parsing and error cases
Implement caching for repeated queries, batch requests where possible, manage token costs
Track usage patterns, monitor costs, measure response quality and latency

examples.input: Add AI-powered customer support chat to our SaaS app
examples.output: LLM integration with prompt engineering, context management, fallback handling, and cost optimization
examples.context: Adding conversational AI to existing SaaS product

examples.input: Build RAG pipeline for querying our documentation
examples.output: Document chunking, embedding generation, vector database setup, and query-time retrieval augmented generation
examples.context: Building knowledge base search with AI
